hall-of-thanes:
Hall of Thanes is the royal dwarven burial chamber beneath Ironforge in Dun Morogh, and someone has broken in. The entrance is a dungeon door beneath Ironforge, and the hall suits levels 13 to 20. You face four level 16 bosses in this order: Faldrim Anvilmar, Magmatus, Plunder and finally Durgen Dirgehammer.

Alliance players get the most out of this one. Old Ironforge Incursion from Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh asks for Durgen Dirgehammer's Head and offers a Calibrated Blunderbuss, Ironforge Greathammer or Deepblaze, plus Ironforge and Gnomeregan Exiles reputation. That chain starts with the Dark Iron Map, dropped by Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh. The Restless Dead from Afadra Dunwall, at the top of Old Ironforge outside the dungeon, pays Ironforge reputation, and both factions can take Important Heirlooms from Thom Filch in Ironforge. Every boss drops rare gear, such as the Fang of Magmatus dagger and Durgen's Crescent Axe. One tip: before you leave Durgen's room, open the vaults in the Reliquary of Kings and click the stone tablet. It starts The Treaty of Understanding, which you hand to Magni Bronzebeard for 16s and more reputation.
ragefire-chasm:
Ragefire Chasm is a set of molten caverns beneath Orgrimmar, full of troggs and Burning Blade cultists. You enter from the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar, and it fits levels 13 to 18. The four bosses, all level 16, come in this order: Oggleflint, Taragaman the Hungerer, Jergosh the Invoker and Bazzalan.

This is a Horde dungeon, and the quests send you here from the capitals. Talk to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff for Testing an Enemy's Strength and Searching for the Lost Satchel. The satchel leads to Returning the Lost Satchel, worth Thunder Bluff reputation and a choice of Featherbead Bracers, Savannah Bracers or Garrison Cuffs. Varimathras in the Undercity offers The Power to Destroy..., which rewards leggings and Undercity reputation. Hidden Enemies from Thrall needs the earlier steps of that chain done in Orgrimmar first. For loot, look for the Cursed Felblade from Taragaman and the Robe of Evocation from Jergosh. To find Maur Grimtotem's corpse, take the right-hand tunnel at the first big three-way junction, head uphill toward the dead end and check the small side room on the left.
ruins-of-lordaeron:
The Ruins of Lordaeron fill the ruined capital city, where Scourge forces linger and a necromancer gathers power. The dungeon entrance is in the Ruins of Lordaeron, and the level range is 15 to 22. In journal order you meet The Baron, Witherfang, Viktor the Vile, The Abandoned, Bjork and finally Rath'mael. Lordaeron Captain is a rare spawn that only the Horde can kill, since he is friendly to the Alliance.

Both sides have good quests. Horde players should grab The Wrath of Rath'mael from Deathguard Kristof in Brill for Undercity reputation and a Forsaken Greataxe or Gnarled Necromancer's Staff, plus Light's Justice from Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity. Alliance players can pick up Abominable Creatures from Captain Truman, just inside to the left of the entrance, for a choice of Monstrous Cleaver, Grave Shroud or Slain Baron's Signet. Watch for the Crest of Lordaeron, which starts a quest for either faction and rewards a Small Sack of Gems. Players report it on tower upper floors, in rooms near The Baron and around Bjork. From Rath'mael, the Mirror of Rath'mael shield and Coldspire Staff are worth a look.
the-deadmines:
The Deadmines lie under Moonbrook in Westfall, where the Defias Brotherhood is building a warship. The entrance is in Moonbrook, and the dungeon covers levels 17 to 26. Bosses come in this order: Rhahk'Zor, Sneed's Shredder, Sneed, Gilnid, Mr. Smite, Captain Greenskin, Edwin VanCleef and Cookie. Miner Johnson is a rare spawn in the side passage after Rhahk'Zor.

Almost every quest here is for the Alliance. The big one is The Defias Brotherhood from Gryan Stoutmantle at the Sentinel Hill tower: finish the earlier steps, then bring back VanCleef's head for Stormwind reputation and Westfall gear such as the Staff of Westfall. Red Silk Bandanas from Scout Riell in the same tower offers a weapon. In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Wilder Thistlenettle gives Collecting Memories and Oh Brother..., and both are done in the undead tunnels before the instance portal, so finish them on the way in. VanCleef also drops An Unsent Letter, which starts a chain that continues with Bazil Thredd. For loot, look out for the Cape of the Brotherhood from VanCleef and Smite's Mighty Hammer from Mr. Smite.
wailing-caverns:
Wailing Caverns lies deep under the Northern Barrens, where druids and fanglords guard the sleeping Naralex. You enter through a cave at Lushwater Oasis, and it suits levels 15 to 24. The bosses in order are Lord Cobrahn, Lady Anacondra, Kresh, Lord Pythas, Skum, Lord Serpentis, Verdan the Everliving and Mutanus the Devourer. The Deviate Faerie Dragon is a rare spawn.

Several quests work for both factions. Nalpak and Ebru stand above the entrance: Deviate Hides rewards Slick Deviate Leggings or a Deviate Hide Pack, and Deviate Eradication offers a Sizzle Stick or Dagmire Gauntlets. Grab Smart Drinks and Trouble at the Docks in Ratchet before you head out. Horde players should aim for Leaders of the Fang from Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff, which pays Thunder Bluff reputation and a Crescent Staff, Wingblade or Hammerbone. It only opens after the Barrens oasis chain, so start that early. Mutanus drops the Glowing Shard, which starts its own quest. For gear, Lord Serpentis drops the Venomstrike bow and Verdan drops the Living Root staff.
shadowfang-keep:
Shadowfang Keep stands in Silverpine Forest, where Archmage Arugal and his worgen hold the keep above Pyrewood Village. The entrance is north of Pyrewood Village, and the dungeon covers levels 20 to 30. Bosses come in this order: Rethilgore, the optional Fel Steed or Shadow Charger, Razorclaw the Butcher, Baron Silverlaine, Commander Springvale, Odo the Blindwatcher, Arugal's Voidwalker, Fenrus the Devourer, Wolf Master Nandos and Archmage Arugal. The Deathsworn Captain is a rare spawn.

Horde players have the best quests. Arugal Must Die from Dalar Dawnweaver at The Sepulcher rewards the Seal of Sylvanas and Undercity reputation. High Executor Hadrec, also at The Sepulcher, gives Deathstalkers in Shadowfang, and Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity offers The Book of Ur. Class quests pass through here too. Alliance paladins pick up Jordan's Smithing Hammer from Jordan's Hammer in the courtyard, and Horde paladins find the Enchanted Silver Ingot on a table in Arugal's room after he dies. Warlocks collect Soran'ruk Fragments here and in Blackfathom Deeps. For loot, Arugal drops the Robes of Arugal and Meteor Shard, and Commander Springvale drops the Worgenbane Talisman.
blackfathom-deeps:
Blackfathom Deeps is a flooded night elf ruin on the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, held by naga, murlocs and Twilight's Hammer cultists who serve Aku'mai. The entrance is on the Zoram Strand, and the level range is 24 to 32. You face Ghamoo-ra, Lady Sarevess, Gelihast, Lorgus Jett, Old Serra'kis, Twilight Lord Kelris and finally Aku'mai.

Both factions can take Blackfathom Villainy from Argent Guard Thaelrid inside the dungeon. Killing Kelris pays 65s, Argent Dawn reputation and a choice such as the Gravestone Scepter. Alliance players must finish In Search of Thaelrid from Dawnwatcher Shaedlass in Darnassus before accepting it, or that quest is lost. Alliance players should also take Twilight Falls in Darnassus and Researching the Corruption in Auberdine. Horde players can work through Je'neu Sancrea's quests at Zoram'gar Outpost. Amongst the Ruins has you loot the Fathom Core, which spawns Baron Aquanis and leads to a quest with gear rewards. For Knowledge in the Deeps, the Lorgalis Manuscript sits in a Pitted Iron Chest underwater in the Pool of Ask'ar, in the northern alcove past Ghamoo-ra's room. Aku'mai can drop Strike of the Hydra.
the-stockade:
The Stockade is Stormwind's prison, now overrun by Defias prisoners. You enter from the Canal District in Stormwind City, and the level range is 24 to 32. Bosses in journal order are Targorr the Dread, Kam Deepfury, Hamhock, Dextren Ward and Bazil Thredd. Bruegal Ironknuckle is a rare spawn.

Every quest here is Alliance, and several start far from Stormwind, so collect them before you go. Guard Berton in Lakeshire wants Targorr's head for What Comes Around..., and Councilman Millstipe in Darkshire wants Dextren Ward's hand for Crime and Punishment. Both pay Stormwind reputation and gear such as the Lucine Longsword or Darkshire Mail Leggings. The Fury Runs Deep from Motley Garmason in Dun Modr rewards Headbasher or the Belt of Vindication, but you need The Dark Iron War done first. Warden Thelwater outside the gates gives Quell the Uprising and The Stockade Riots, and Nikova Raskol in Old Town gives The Color of Blood, so even the trash earns reputation. The Stockade Riots belongs to the chain that starts with The Unsent Letter from Edwin VanCleef. Bazil Thredd drops the Debt Collector sword and the Concealed Hand Crossbow.
excavation-site-wetlands:
Excavation Site: Wetlands is a Titan dig site trapped in time above Whelgar's Excavation, and its Titan constructs no longer obey anyone. Reach it from Thelgen Rock: the entrance is a blue mist portal under a large tree in the hills southeast of Whelgar's Excavation. It suits levels 26 to 33, and inside you pass the Lost Marsh, Stalker's Thicket, Site of the Guardian and Lost Dig Site. The bosses are Saltspine, a white crocolisk, then Shadetooth, a giant violet raptor, and finally the Relic Guardian, a stone Titan construct.

Both factions have a Titan Relic quest worth 60s and a Heavehammer or Healer's Staff: Alliance take Prehistoric Prism from Prospector Whelgar, and Horde take Earthen Echo from Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. Alliance players can also get Horrors in the Highland from Rethiel the Greenwarden for an Ironwood Destroyer or Hornbeam Heft. Songblade Search leads to Daewyn Songblade inside, whose follow-up gives Daewyn's Girdle. Horde players can do Changing Tastes for Borstan in Orgrimmar: Thicket Raptor Meat comes from the raptors in Stalker's Thicket, Shadetooth's area. The Relic Guardian drops the Golemsight Long Gun and the Ring of Power Regulation.
city-of-dalaran:
The City of Dalaran is the restored mage city in Alterac Mountains, now a five-player dungeon in WoW Forever. To get in, drop through a grate in the streets into the sewers and follow the Underbelly pipe to the portal. It suits levels 28 to 35. You fight Atrexis the Grave Knight at the ritual circle in the Underbelly, then the Arcane Anomaly on a terrace in the streets, the Fel Ancient, the Unstable Sentinel by the Magus Commerce Exchange, the Mana Devourer and the Arcanic Enigma. Lyn the Ignored is a rare elite. The final boss, Shade of the Archmage, waits in the Violet Citadel.

Alliance players can take Power Overwhelming from High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind for 1g and a Violet Sash or Runebound Gloves. The Image of Archmage Modera at Lordamere Lake offers Kirin Tor reputation for Starving Arcane and Heart of Disruption. Horde players do their own Heart of Disruption as part of the Dalaran attunement, and The Grave Knight from Melisara in Tarren Mill pays 1g. Against the Shade, don't stand in line with the Bounding Mana target, and nobody should leave the room or he resets. He drops the Archmagister's Faceted Pendant.
gnomeregan:
Gnomeregan is the irradiated underground city of the gnomes in Dun Morogh, overrun by troggs and Mekgineer Thermaplugg's forces. Take the elevator down in north-west Dun Morogh and keep left through the tunnels to reach the portal. It covers levels 29 to 38. Bosses come in this order: Grubbis with his pet Chomper, Viscous Fallout in the Hall of Gears, Electrocutioner 6000 in the Engineering Labs, Crowd Pummeler 9-60 in the Launch Bay arena and Mekgineer Thermaplugg in Tinkers' Court. The Dark Iron Ambassador is a rare spawn.

Alliance players should take The Grand Betrayal from High Tinker Mekkatorque in Ironforge, and Horde players take Rig Wars from Nogg in Orgrimmar. Both reward a choice of Civinad Robes, Triprunner Dungarees or Dual Reinforced Leggings. Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators from Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind offers Shoni's Disarming Tool, and either faction can escort Kernobee for A Fine Mess. Ironforge has several more quest givers, so Alliance players should stop there first. In the final fight, hit the bomb-face buttons to stop the walking bombs. Thermaplugg drops Thermaplugg's Central Core and the Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator.
razorfen-kraul:
Razorfen Kraul is a sprawling thorn maze in the southern Barrens, held by quilboar. The entrance is at the end of the thorny corridor, and the dungeon suits levels 29 to 38. Bosses in order are Roogug near the start, Aggem Thorncurse, Death Speaker Jargba, Overlord Ramtusk, Agathelos the Raging and Charlga Razorflank, the final boss deep in the Kraul. Blind Hunter, found in the bat caves, and Earthcaller Halmgar are rare spawns.

Charlga is the target of two matching quests. Alliance players take The Crone of the Kraul from Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar, and Horde players take A Vengeful Fate from Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff. Both offer Berylline Pads, a Stonefist Girdle or a Marbled Buckler. Willix the Importer, inside the dungeon, gives either faction an escort quest that rewards one of four rings. Blueleaf Tubers from Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet pays Ratchet reputation, but grab the Crate with Holes, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Snufflenose Owner's Manual next to him before you leave. Warriors on their armor quest need the Vial of Phlogiston from Roogug. Charlga drops Agamaggan's Clutch and the Heart of Agamaggan.
scarlet-monastery-graveyard:
The Graveyard is one of the wings of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Walk into the monastery courtyard and take the portal on the right. It suits levels 30 to 38.

Interrogator Vishas waits in the Chamber of Atonement. Three rare spawns may show up along the way: Azshir the Sleepless, the Fallen Champion and Ironspine. Bloodmage Thalnos is the final boss, in Honor's Tomb. His best drop is the Orb of the Forgotten Seer, a rare off-hand, and Ironspine can drop Ironspine's Ribcage and Ironspine's Fist if you are lucky enough to find him.

Horde players get the most out of this wing. Vorrel Sengutz, inside the Graveyard, gives Vorrel's Revenge: kill Vishas for Vorrel's Wedding Ring and bring it to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill for Undercity reputation and a choice of Mantle of Woe or Grimsteel Cape. Pick up Hearts of Zeal from Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity before you go, since Scarlet mobs drop the hearts in every wing. Rogues on The Eye of Bhossca should wear the Scarlet Initiate's Uniform: stealth or attacking removes it.
scarlet-monastery-library:
The Library is a wing of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, with its own portal door inside the monastery. It is aimed at levels 33 to 41 and has two bosses.

Houndmaster Loksey holds the Huntsman's Cloister with his dogs. He can drop the Dog Whistle trinket and Loksey's Training Stick. Arcanist Doan is the final boss, in the Athenaeum, and drops the Hypnotic Blade and the Illusionary Rod. Do not leave without opening Doan's Strongbox behind him: it holds The Scarlet Key, which you need to open the Armory and the Cathedral.

Alliance players should take Past Due from Magus Olvek in Dalaran, a quest new in Forever: Doan holds the book, and it rewards Kirin Tor reputation and Knucklebound Thimble or Salve and Salvation. Mythology of the Titans, from Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge, gives the Explorers' League Commendation. Horde players can take Compendium of the Fallen from Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff for the Vile Protector, Forcestone Buckler or Omega Orb, though Undead cannot take it. Loksey also counts toward Into The Scarlet Monastery and In the Name of the Light, so grab those first.
the-drowned-city:
The Drowned City is I'lalai, a Gurubashi troll city risen from the sea off Stranglethorn Vale, west of Grom'gol. It is an open-air dungeon for levels 35 to 42. To get in, swim underwater west of the Vile Reef to Sunken Hollow, by the island with the water elementals. The cave has a large tablet beside it.

Zul'Alai, an undead troll, enrages near death and hits the whole group hard. Next come Var'Taka, leader of the naga, and Captain Dreadrise. Deathless Marrow and the Primeval Elemental are fought together, and the elemental can drop the Heart of the Primeval trinket. Gill, Umbra and "Pyromancer" Braxton are rare spawns. The storm builds before the final boss, Min'loth the Serpent, who drops the Maw of Min'loth shield.

Both factions can take Shady Saltseers and The Saltseer Captain from Krazek in Booty Bay for Booty Bay reputation and the Saltseer's Helm or South Seas Shroud. Horde players start at Kin'weelay in Grom'gol, whose tablet rubbings lead to A Tale Spun Around the Fire. Alliance players visit Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore for Findings for the Explorer's League and its Intrepid Explorer's Chainmail.
scarlet-monastery-armory:
The Armory is a wing of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, for levels 36 to 44. Its door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from Doan's Strongbox in the Library, so clear the Library first if nobody has it.

This wing has a single boss. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, waits at the end in the Hall of Champions. Be ready after he dies: a wave of Scarlet Trainees rushes into the room, so keep your health and mana up for one more fight. Herod is known for the Ravager, a rare two-handed axe, and he can also drop Herod's Shoulder and the Raging Berserker's Helm. The trash can drop the Scarlet Belt and Scarlet Boots.

Herod is one of the four targets in the big Monastery quests. Horde players take Into The Scarlet Monastery from Varimathras in Undercity, for the Sword of Omen, Prophetic Cane or Dragon's Blood Necklace. Alliance players take In the Name of the Light from Raleigh the Devout in Southshore, which pays Stormwind reputation and one of four items, including Bonebiter. Both also need Loksey in the Library and Mograine and Whitemane in the Cathedral.
scarlet-monastery-cathedral:
The Cathedral is the heart of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, for levels 38 to 46. Its door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key, found in Doan's Strongbox in the Library. Inside are the Chapel Gardens and the Crusader's Chapel.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks is easy to miss. He hides behind the altar room, through the door at the back of the chapel. Scarlet Commander Mograine stands at the altar of the Crusader's Chapel. When he falls, High Inquisitor Whitemane comes out of the back room and resurrects him, so plan for both at once. Mograine can drop the Aegis of the Scarlet Commander and Mograine's Might, and Whitemane can drop the Triune Amulet and the Hand of Righteousness.

Mograine and Whitemane finish the big Monastery quests: Into The Scarlet Monastery from Varimathras in Undercity for the Horde, and In the Name of the Light from Raleigh the Devout in Southshore for the Alliance. Alliance Paladins on A Brother In Need will find Aeonas in the rear chamber. Finish Katherine's talk about Aeonas before you leave, as players report that skipping it can block the next step, which leads to the Pauldrons of Vindication.
razorfen-downs:
Razorfen Downs is the old quilboar burial ground in the far south of the Barrens, on the border with Thousand Needles. Go through the thorny tunnel to reach the entrance. The Scourge now holds it, and it suits levels 37 to 46.

Ring the gong on the Spiral of Thorns to summon Tuten'kash, a spider boss. Then come Plaguemaw the Rotting, Mordresh Fire Eye in the room with the bone pile and floating skulls, and Glutton on the path up the Downs. Ragglesnout is a rare spawn near the top and can drop X'caliboar. Amnennar the Coldbringer is the final boss at the top, with Robes of the Lich and the Icemetal Barbute among his drops.

Kill Amnennar for Bring the End (Horde, Andrew Brownell in Undercity) or Bring the Light (Alliance, Archbishop Benedictus in Stormwind). Both reward the Amberglow Talisman or Purified Ring. The Coldbringer's Eye pays 300 Kirin Tor or Earthen Ring reputation. Extinguishing the Idol, an escort for Belnistrasz, gives the Dragonclaw Ring, but every group member must finish the previous step first. Horde players should do An Unholy Alliance before entering: Ambassador Malcin is in the tents of the outdoor thorn maze.
kroldok-stronghold:
Krol'dok Stronghold is an ogre fortress in the northern Riverglades, for levels 40 to 47. It sits on the hill above Sunnyglade. Skip the big fortress gates: the way in is the small cave just west of them.

The bosses are Slavecrusher Grox, Twilight Commander Zarmok, War Handler Ashka, Nar'gurk and Bossman Toof, with Kroog as a rare spawn. Overlord Mugg is the leader. He can drop the Emblem of Slamming trinket and two fist weapons, Mugg's Jabber and Mugg's Crosser. Nar'gurk is the one to watch for plate wearers, with the Krol'dok Warplate Chest and Helmet.

Both factions get Eye of Mugg, for killing the leader, with a choice of Rock on Stick, Stick No Rock or Bigger Rock on Bigger Stick. Horde players take it from Krom'rosh in Rog'mar, Alliance players from Commander Demar Brant at Farholde Keep, which also pays Brotherhood of the Horse reputation. Alliance players can add Vengeance of the Highborne from Ranath Nightstride in the Dalaran inn for 250 Kirin Tor reputation. Keep any Krol'dok Moulding you loot: it starts the chain to Key Ingredients, whose Krol'dok Compound Key opens a shortcut to the last boss.
uldaman:
Uldaman is a titan vault under the northern Badlands, overrun by troggs and Shadowforge dwarves. It covers levels 41 to 51. Go through the excavation cave north of Angor Fortress to the stone door at the back.

Revelosh drops The Shaft of Tsol for the Staff of Prehistoria, which opens Ironaya's door in the Map Chamber. The Lost Dwarves, Baelog, Eric "The Swift" and Olaf, are a Horde-only fight, as they are friendly to the Alliance. After Ironaya come the Obsidian Sentinel, the Ancient Stone Keeper, Galgann Firehammer and Grimlok. Blizzard has switched off the Obsidian Sentinel's loot for now. Archaedas, the final boss, wakes when you use the altar and can drop the Archaedic Stone ring and Stoneslayer.

The Platinum Discs is worth taking for both factions: the Discs of Norgannon are in the Map Chamber past Ironaya, and the chain ends with a Superior Healing Potion or Greater Mana Potion plus reputation. The necklace chains give Talvash's Enhancing Necklace for the Alliance or Jarkal's Enhancing Necklace for the Horde. Remember that Grimlok drops the sapphire and Archaedas drops the power source. Solution to Doom, from Theldurin the Lost, rewards the Doomsayer's Robe or Doomcaller's Pants.
zulfarrak:
Zul'Farrak is the Sandfury troll city in north-west Tanaris, for levels 44 to 54. The entrance is the gate of the city itself.

You will face Theka the Martyr, Antu'sul in the basilisk pit, and Witch Doctor Zum'rah, whose graveyard fills with zombies. The pyramid event brings Nekrum Gutchewer and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz. Afterwards, speak to Weegli Blastfuse to open the gate and face Sergeant Bly and his companions. Hydromancer Velratha patrols the pool, and Gahz'rilla is summoned at the Gong of Zul'Farrak with the Mallet of Zul'Farrak. Zerillis, Sandarr Dunereaver and Dustwraith are rare spawns. Chief Ukorz Sandscalp and Ruuzlu are one fight on top of the temple. Ukorz can drop Ripsaw and Big Bad Pauldrons, and Gahz'rilla can drop Gahz'rilla Scale Armor.

Both factions can take Gahz'rilla from Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats for the Carrot on a Stick, and Divino-matic Rod from Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan for 200 Gadgetzan reputation. Zum'rah's head pays 300 Kirin Tor (Alliance, The Witch Doctor's Head) or 300 Earthen Ring reputation (Horde, Zum'rah's Head). If you have Tran'rek in your log, hand it in first, or you can't accept Scarab Shells.
maraudon:
Maraudon is the sacred centaur cave system in western Desolace, for levels 46 to 55. Go through the Valley of Spears into the cave mouth below the Maraudon cliffs. Orange and purple wings lead to the inner caves.

Noxxion and Razorlash guard the orange wing, and Lord Vyletongue rules the purple wing, where Meshlok the Harvester is a rare spawn. Celebras the Cursed waits in the Wicked Grotto. Past him, Landslide and Tinkerer Gizlock hold the Foulspore Cavern, and Rotgrip lurks in the waterfall cave. Princess Theradras is the final boss in the Earth Song Falls. She can drop the Blade of Eternal Darkness, an epic dagger.

Take Legends of Maraudon from Cavindra at the orange entrance. Noxxion drops the Celebrian Rod and Vyletongue the Celebrian Diamond. After you kill Celebras the Cursed, Celebras the Redeemed starts The Scepter of Celebras: the scepter opens the waterfall shortcut. Corruption of Earth and Seed, from Selendra (Horde) or Keeper Marandis (Alliance), rewards the Thrash Blade, Resurgence Rod or Verdant Keeper's Aim. Zaetar's Spirit appears after Theradras dies and gives Seed of Life for Cenarion Circle reputation. Shadowshard Fragments needs no instance run at all.
alcaz-prison:
Alcaz Prison sits on Alcaz Island, off the north-east coast of Dustwallow Marsh, and suits levels 48 to 55. From the dock, take the path up the hill to the prison building at the north end. The portal is in its cellar. Inside, the Defias Brotherhood and the naga are at war.

You will meet Overseer Wrex, The Questioner, Tidemistress Ca'zass, Katerina the Cleaner and finally Blazeroar. The Questioner can drop the Fingerbreaker Stamp trinket, and Blazeroar can drop Zarla's Snack Pouch, another trinket.

Alliance players should take The Dragon's Journal from Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran: recover Zarla's Journal for 300 Kirin Tor reputation. A Bit of Wet Work, from Sully McCleary in the Theramore inn, asks for the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass. Horde players get the same task as A Little Payback from Sergeant Ulka, outside the prison, for Orgrimmar reputation and gear such as Kor'kron Battle Gauntlets. Commander Folkar, inside, starts Thrall Needs to Know. One warning for everyone: don't kill The Questioner before the last boss, or you can't get More Valuable Than Gold from Mason Connery. Its Document Box sells for 25g.
sunken-temple:
The Sunken Temple is the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, under the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows. It covers levels 50 to 60. Dive in and follow the stairs down to the temple door.

Six troll guardians stand on the balconies round the ring: Gasher, Hukku, Loro, Mijan, Zolo and Zul'Lor. All six must die before Jammal'an the Prophet comes down to fight beside Ogom the Wretched. Atal'alarion is summoned in the statue circle on the upper level. The green dragons come in pairs, Morphaz and Hazzas, then Dreamscythe and Weaver. The Shade of Eranikus is the final boss and can drop Dragon's Call, an epic sword. The Avatar of Hakkar is summoned at the central altar with the Filled Egg of Hakkar.

The God Hakkar, from Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port, pays 2g 40s and gear such as the Gemburst Circlet. Jammal'an the Prophet, from the Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands, rewards the Helm of Exile among others. The Shade's Essence of Eranikus starts a quest for the Chained Essence of Eranikus. Many class quests need Voodoo Feathers from the six guardians, and Morphaz drops items for the hunter, rogue, priest and mage quests.
blackrock-depths:
Blackrock Depths sits inside Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes. Take the chain down from the Blackrock Spire ledge and follow the lower path to the Depths portal. It covers levels 52 to 60. You start in the Detention Block with High Interrogator Gerstahn, Lord Roccor and Houndmaster Grebmar, then face one of six challengers in the Ring of Law. Further in are Pyromancer Loregrain, Fineous Darkvire, Warder Stilgiss, Lord Incendius, Bael'Gar, General Angerforge, Golem Lord Argelmach and the Grim Guzzler crowd. Ambassador Flamelash, The Seven and Magmus lead to Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. Panzor the Invincible is a rare spawn.

The Emperor can drop Ironfoe and Hand of Justice. Alliance players should take The Fate of the Kingdom from King Magni Bronzebeard, and Horde players The Royal Rescue from Thrall. For both, keep Princess Moira Bronzebeard alive. Jail Break! gives Stormwind reputation, and Operation: Death to Angerforge gives Orgrimmar reputation. Do Dark Iron Legacy early: its Shadowforge Key opens shortcuts inside.
lower-blackrock-spire:
Lower Blackrock Spire is in Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes. Climb to the upper ledge to reach the Blackrock Spire portal. It is meant for levels 55 to 60. Highlord Omokk leads the Spirestone ogres, with the rare Spirestone Butcher, Spirestone Battle Lord and Spirestone Lord Magus nearby. The Smolderthorn trolls bring Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin and War Master Voone. Mother Smolderweb and the rare Crystal Fang wait in the Skitterweb Tunnels, and Urok Doomhowl is summoned at his pike. After Quartermaster Zigris you fight Halycon and Gizrul the Slavener, then Overlord Wyrmthalak. Bannok Grimaxe, Ghok Bashguud and the Burning Felguard are rare spawns.

Seal of Ascension, from Vaelan inside the dungeon, is the key quest: bring him the gemstones from Omokk, Voone and Wyrmthalak. It is the first step toward opening Upper Blackrock Spire. Maxwell's Mission for Alliance or Warlord's Command for Horde rewards items like Wyrmthalak's Shackles. Overlord Wyrmthalak can drop Mark of the Dragon Lord. For Mother's Milk, let Mother Smolderweb poison you and don't let anyone cleanse it.
upper-blackrock-spire:
Upper Blackrock Spire is in Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes. Climb to the Blackrock Spire portal and go through Lower Blackrock Spire to the sealed door, which needs the Seal of Ascension. It is a level 59 to 60 dungeon. You wake Pyroguard Emberseer in the Hall of Binding, then call Solakar Flamewreath in the Rookery. Jed Runewatcher is a rare spawn. Goraluk Anvilcrack comes next, then Gyth and Warchief Rend Blackhand in the Blackrock Stadium. The Beast waits past the Stadium, and General Drakkisath is the final boss. Lord Valthalak is a summoned quest event.

Rend Blackhand can drop Felstriker, and General Drakkisath can drop Blackblade of Shahram. Finish the Seal of Ascension chain with Vaelan first. Then take Blackhand's Command: touching Drakkisath's Brand behind the General unlocks the Orb of Command shortcut to Blackwing Lair. The Onyxia attunement runs through here too, with Drakefire Amulet for Alliance and Blood of the Black Dragon Champion for Horde. General Drakkisath's Demise (Alliance) and For The Horde! (Horde) offer Mark of Tyranny, Eye of the Beast or Blackhand's Breadth.
dire-maul-east:
Dire Maul: East is in central Feralas, inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas. Go through the Broken Commons to the gate on the east side. It suits levels 54 to 60. You start by chasing the imp Pusillin through the Warpwood Quarter until he fights you. Then you face Zevrim Thornhoof at the sacrificial altar, Hydrospawn in the pool below the bridge and Lethtendris with her pet Pimgib. Alzzin the Wildshaper is the final boss, and Isalien is a summoned quest event in his hall.

Pusillin drops the Crescent Key, which opens the other wings, so this is a good first stop. Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin, from Azj'Tordin at Lariss Pavilion, rewards Spry Boots, Sprinter's Sword or Incanter's Pantaloons. Lethtendris's Web comes from Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold for Alliance and from Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache for Horde. Shards of the Felvine needs Alzzin dead: pick up a Felvine Shard near the vine and seal it in the Reliquary of Purity. Good drops include Fiendish Machete from Alzzin and Waveslicer from Hydrospawn.
dire-maul-west:
Dire Maul: West is in central Feralas, inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas. Its door opens with the Crescent Key, which Pusillin drops in Dire Maul: East. It is meant for levels 56 to 60. Tendris Warpwood guards the Capital Gardens, where the rare Tsu'zee hides in stealth. Magister Kalendris and Illyanna Ravenoak stand on the pylon terraces. Once all five pylons are shut down, the force field drops and you can fight Immol'thar. Lord Hel'nurath is optional and summoned by warlocks. Prince Tortheldrin is the final boss, in the Athenaeum.

Take The Madness Within from the Shen'dralar Ancient. After Immol'thar and Tortheldrin, return to the Ancient for The Treasure of the Shen'dralar, then open the chest under the library stairs for Bonecrusher, Backwood Helm or Sedge Boots. Elven Legends, from Scholar Runethorn (Alliance) or Sage Korolusk (Horde), sends you to the remains beside Lorekeeper Lydros and unlocks his libram exchanges. The Gauntlet of Gordok Might sits in a chest near Tortheldrin, for Unfinished Gordok Business in North. Watch for Mindtap Talisman from Magister Kalendris and Evil Eye Pendant from Immol'thar.
dire-maul-north:
Dire Maul: North, the Gordok wing, is in central Feralas inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas. Its door opens with the Crescent Key from Pusillin in the East wing. It covers levels 56 to 60. Ogres hold Gordok Commons: Guard Mol'dar, Stomper Kreeg, Guard Fengus, Guard Slip'kik and Captain Kromcrush. King Gordok is the final boss, fought together with Cho'Rush the Observer. Killing him makes you the new Gordok king.

If you spare the guards and Captain Kromcrush, the Tribute Run, the Gordok Tribute Chest gets better, and it can hold Treant's Bane. King Gordok can drop Crown of the Ogre King. The Gordok Ogre Suit from Knot Thimblejack lets you walk past Guard Slip'kik and talk to Kromcrush instead of fighting. The Ogre Tannin is in a basket on the upper level beyond Knot. Make your suits before you free Knot with a Gordok Shackle Key, because he leaves. As king, take Unfinished Gordok Business from Kromcrush for one of four Gordok hand pieces. Elven Legends unlocks repeatable libram quests with Lorekeeper Lydros, such as Libram of Rapidity.
blackmaw-hold:
Blackmaw Hold is a furbolg city in northern Azshara, built for levels 55 to 60. Enter at the old furbolg gate and follow the long tunnel into the mountain. The portal is at its far end, under Darkwhisper Gorge by the Winterspring border. It is a large dungeon with several routes. The journal lists Impaan the Imprisoner, Bonesnout the Unbroken, Withermaw, Elder Shaman Bloodmane, Blackmaw Behemoth, Unbound Spirit and finally Varrox Bleakhoof. Moontouched Wanderer, Gortek the Apprentice and Tunnelweb Matriarch are rare spawns.

Most quests here give Timbermaw Hold reputation. Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore, from Ogtinc in Azshara, rewards Great Bear Claw, Staff of Wild Beasts or Wild Malleus. Withermaw and Bonesnout are on different paths, so take both. Blackmaw Reclamation, from Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan, asks for Varrox Bleakhoof's Head and offers items like Ouroboros Ring. Players report it needs Friendly with Timbermaw Hold. Blackmaw Magic sends you after Elder Shaman Bloodmane for Kirin Tor reputation (Alliance) or Earthen Ring reputation (Horde). Look out for Bloody Claws of Attack from Bloodmane and Flamebreak Talisman from Unbound Spirit.
stratholme-living:
Stratholme: Living is the main gate of Stratholme, in north-west Eastern Plaguelands, for levels 58 to 60. Skul is a rare spawn near the entrance, and Hearthsinger Forresten is a rare spawn in a house on Festival Lane. The Unforgiven haunts the square past the gate, and Timmy the Cruel appears once Crusaders' Square is cleared. Malor the Zealous, Postmaster Malown and Ezra Grimm are optional. Cannon Master Willey stands on Market Row, Archivist Galford keeps the Scarlet Archive, and Balnazzar is the final boss in the Hall of Lights. Jarien and Sothos are a summoned quest event.

Balnazzar can drop Book of the Dead and Pattern: Truefaith Vestments. Take The Archivist from Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel and hand it in first, or the Head of Balnazzar will not start The Truth Comes Crashing Down. Before you burn the archive, take the painting for Of Love and Family from behind the twin-moons picture in Galford's room. Houses of the Holy, from Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, rewards Crown of the Penitent or Band of the Penitent. Malor's Strongbox holds the Medallion of Faith for Aurius on the Undead side.
stratholme-undead:
Stratholme: Undead is the Scourge side of the city, reached through the service entrance on the east side, in the north of the Eastern Plaguelands. It suits levels 58 to 60. Stonespine is a rare gargoyle near the start. Nerub'enkan, Baroness Anastari and Maleki the Pallid each hold one of the three ziggurats. Magistrate Barthilas runs from Elders' Square to the gate of the Baron's stronghold. Once the ziggurats are cleared, Ramstein the Gorger waits in the Slaughter Square, and Baron Rivendare is the final boss in the Slaughter House.

Baron Rivendare can drop the Runeblade of Baron Rivendare. Dead Man's Plea, from Anthion Harmon, is timed: kill the Baron within 45 minutes to rescue Ysida Harmon. Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to see Anthion. The Active Agent, from Betina Bigglezink at Light's Hope Chapel, rewards Seal of the Dawn or Rune of the Dawn. Bring the Medallion of Faith from the Living side to Aurius before the Baron fight for Aurius' Reckoning. Horde players can take Ramstein from Nathanos Blightcaller for Royal Seal of Alexis or Elemental Circle.
scholomance:
Scholomance lies on Caer Darrow, the island in Darrowmere Lake in Western Plaguelands. The entrance is the crypt door at the back of the keep, and the level range is 58 to 60. The Skeleton Key from the Barov quests opens its doors. Kirtonos the Herald is summoned on the porch. Inside you meet Jandice Barov, Rattlegore, Marduk Blackpool and Vectus, then Ras Frostwhisper in the Barov family vault. Six side-room bosses follow: Instructor Malicia, Doctor Theolen Krastinov, Lorekeeper Polkelt, The Ravenian, Lord Alexei Barov and Lady Illucia Barov. Kill all six to summon Darkmaster Gandling in the Headmaster's Study.

Gandling can drop Headmaster's Charge, and Ras Frostwhisper can drop Alanna's Embrace. For The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper from Magistrate Marduke, use the Soulbound Keepsake on him and bring back his human head for Warblade of Caer Darrow, Crown of Caer Darrow or Darrowspike. Dawn's Gambit, from Betina Bigglezink, pays Windreaper or Dancing Sliver. Barov Family Fortune comes from Weldon Barov for Alliance or Alexi Barov for Horde. The Deed to Caer Darrow is by Lord Alexei Barov, and the Brill deed is by Ras Frostwhisper.
shapers-terrace:
Shaper's Terrace is an ancient titan facility on the northern rim of Un'Goro Crater, on the hill right above Marshal's Refuge. Climb the stairs to the titan temple to get in. It is a level 58 to 60 dungeon. You collect power crystals across Un'Goro and use them at the consoles inside. The journal lists Titanosaur, Venomridge, Thunderhoof, Direhorn Matriarch, Cinder, Bolt, Snowtalon and Vitrix. Izha'Rel and Tor'Rel are two raptors fought together, and they are not elite. Nanaya comes last.

Every quest here gives reputation. Horde players can take Crystalline Elements from Mayena Earthseeker in Mulgore for Earthen Ring reputation, plus Essence of Seeping Slimes and The Dark Crystal from The Apothecarium in Undercity. Alliance players get Panic at the Digsite and Mapping the Way Forward from Curator Thorius in the Hall of Explorers, Ironforge. For the map quest, use the Explorers' League Cartographer's Kit at each landmark. Digestible Research starts from the Partially Digested Journal lying on the ground inside the dungeon. Nanaya can drop Nanaya's Control Spire, and Talon of Tor'Rel comes from the raptor pair.
